message.content: {"note_claim": "The claim that Chelsea Clinton received tens of millions of dollars from USAID via the Clinton Foundation is false and has been debunked by fact checks.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The graphic does not say USAID paid any money to the Clinton Foundation; in an X post, DataRepublican said funding is “fungible” and that USAID money moves through “multiple layers,” not directly.", "reason": "PolitiFact rates the claim that USAID paid Chelsea Clinton $84 million False, noting the figure was the foundation's gross receipts and she received $0 compensation, which substantiates the note's debunking of the related claim."}

parsed.note_claim: The claim that Chelsea Clinton received tens of millions of dollars from USAID via the Clinton Foundation is false and has been debunked by fact checks.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The graphic does not say USAID paid any money to the Clinton Foundation; in an X post, DataRepublican said funding is “fungible” and that USAID money moves through “multiple layers,” not directly.
parsed.reason: PolitiFact rates the claim that USAID paid Chelsea Clinton $84 million False, noting the figure was the foundation's gross receipts and she received $0 compensation, which substantiates the note's debunking of the related claim.
